context:
Goal: fewer auto-mode stops on safe acts (your chat, 18:31 CST Nov 8).
Problem (risk): each entry changes what auto mode allows, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): roadmap steps, the triage outbox and debt notes since Nov 7. Local refusal logs cannot be read from the cloud.
Departs from: main's 6 allow entries, plus the 4 you are pushing now — this adds up to 3 more.
The three entries: (1) Merge Tool Read Checks: `merge <pr> --reviewed`, `--lane-lint` and `--review-record` only read and print; never `--confirm`, force or the ok flags. Refused once (runner 9, Nov 7). (2) A lane closes a PR it replaced with one it opened in the same session, with `Replaced by #n` in the body (wider Owner PR Housekeeping); 4 to 5 PRs were stuck on Nov 8; a closed PR can be reopened. (3) A lease-push call may chain a plain archive push `git push origin <b>:refs/heads/archive/<b>`; refused once on Nov 8.
No entry, rightly refused: an agent's create_session, encoded re-sends, a lane's settings writes, a PATCH on an issue comment.
Meanwhile: lanes keep hitting these stops; replaced PRs wait on the close list for a Mac session.

options.gain: No stops for read checks, replaced-PR closes or an archive push before a lease push.
options.how: Lane relayed-yes-allow adds entries 1, 2 and 3 to settings.json autoMode.allow.
options.label: Add all three
options.lose: Three more entries to keep right.

options.gain: Replaced PRs still close only on a Mac session.
options.how: Entries 1 and 3 land; a replaced PR still closes only from a session on your Mac.
options.label: Add 1 and 3 only
